why: The AI review of 4 November 2026 found that the 2.0a result depends on bioavailability F, which 2.0a took as 1 without varying it. Renal clearance (amount in urine / AUC) does not depend on F; the non-renal clearance derived from CL/F does. This plan re-runs the 2.0a comparison across the range of F the data allow and fixes, before computation, what the body map says for each outcome.
what_is_known_before_computation: Not blind. All CC-5013-PK-001, Bridoux 2016 and Kim 2026 values have been seen. The reviewer reported, and the assistant re-computed, the reading A classifications at F = 1, 0.95, 0.90 and 0.85 for the moderate and severe groups (primary creatinine clearances): moderate under-predicted at 1 and 0.95, consistent at 0.90 and 0.85; severe consistent at 1 and 0.95, over-predicted at 0.90 and 0.85. The mass-balance values were read before this plan. The purpose of locking is to fix the display decision and the reporting, not to make the result unknown.

model_with_F.renal_ml_min_normal: fe_normal * dose / AUC_normal (unchanged; does not depend on F)
model_with_F.non_renal_ml_min: F * dose / AUC_normal - renal_normal (true, not apparent); a scenario with a negative value is reported as impossible
model_with_F.reading: A (intact nephron): filtration fu * CrCl and secretion scaled with CrCl / CrCl_ref, as in 2.0a; fu 0.77, CrCl_ref 110
model_with_F.prediction: AUC_group = F * dose / (renal(CrCl) + non_renal); CL/F_group = (renal(CrCl) + non_renal) / F
model_with_F.note: At F = 1 this is exactly the 2.0a reading A model.

scenarios.F_best_supported_basis: Chen 2012: 90.3% (range 87.0-94.6%) of the radioactive dose recovered in urine, so absorption was at least about 0.90; metabolism minimal.
scenarios.F_lower_bound_basis: Unchanged drug in urine, about 84-85% of the dose (EMA 2008; Chen 2012 citing reference 15). Reported, does not decide.
scenarios.creatinine_clearance_primary: as 2.0a primary: normal 110, mild 65, moderate 40, severe 20 mL/min
scenarios.creatinine_clearance_secondary: Chen 2007 Table I means: normal 102.2, mild 64.6, moderate 39.1, severe 23.9 mL/min (reported, does not decide)

comparisons.cc5013_pk001: Mild, moderate, severe without dialysis: AUC against the 95% CI of the arithmetic mean (t, n-1), exactly as 2.0a. Predicted and observed fraction excreted unchanged reported.
comparisons.myeloma: Bridoux 2016 (AUC24, 90% CI of the geometric mean) and Kim 2026 (total CL/F, 90% CI of the mean, de-indexed median eGFR), exactly as the 2.0d comparator, at each F. Reported; they decide only the wording of the myeloma note (D4).
comparisons.esrd: Non-dialysis day at residual CrCl 0, 5 and 10 mL/min, as 2.0c, at each F. Descriptive.

decision_rule.D1_band_status: For the moderate and severe bands separately, take the CC-5013-PK-001 primary classifications at F = 1.0, 0.95 and 0.90. If they are identical, the band keeps its 2.0a status and its text says the result holds for absorption of 90-100%. If they differ, the band gets the status depends_on_bioavailability, drawn in the amber of a partial result, with a text that gives the classification at each F. The result at F = 0.85 is stated in the limitations either way.
decision_rule.D2_recorded_finding: The 2.0a finding that renal elimination falls faster than in proportion to creatinine clearance is recorded as not established if the moderate group is consistent at any F in the best-supported range; otherwise as holding for absorption of 90-100%.
decision_rule.D3_non_renal_arrow: The non-renal arrow keeps its F = 1 value as drawn width but carries the range over the best-supported F and the status depends_on_bioavailability whenever that range spans more than a factor of 1.5.
decision_rule.D4_myeloma_note: The note says whether the main-scenario consistency with Bridoux and Kim in the band holds at every F in the best-supported range, and names any F at which it does not.
decision_rule.not_changed: Model scopes and patient-record outputs (2.0b) are not changed by this plan; a change to them would be a separate documented step.

known_limitations: F is bounded, not measured: absolute bioavailability needs intravenous data, which do not exist for lenalidomide in the pinned sources.
Healthy volunteers in the mass-balance study (6 men); CC-5013-PK-001 subjects had non-malignant kidney disease.
F is assumed the same in every kidney-function group.
At fu 0.77 the moderate group's renal clearance (29.1 mL/min) is at or below filtration alone (30.1), so reading A cannot reproduce its urine fraction at any F (finding 2 of the review).
Statistics differ between comparisons (arithmetic means and 95% CIs for CC-5013-PK-001; geometric means and 90% CIs for Bridoux), as in 2.0a and 2.0d.
